We test the generality of these findings in two open-weight models, Apertus-8B-Instruct-2509 and Gemma-4-E4B-it, extracting emotion contrast vectors across all layers, using two model-generated corpora. We recover valence geometry for both models, with peak PC1--valence correlations

summary.core_problem: 检验“情绪向量”是否只存在于 Claude Sonnet 4.5，还是也能在开源指令模型中被稳定抽取并影响表征几何。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和可复现实证。它把闭源模型上的情绪表征发现迁移到开放权重模型，并观察到不同模型在层深上的表征形成路径并不一致。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在 Apertus-8B-Instruct-2509 和 Gemma-4-E4B-it 上，基于两个模型生成语料构造 emotion contrast vectors，逐层抽取情绪方向，并用心理学中的 valence、arousal 维度分析这些方向的几何结构。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两个开源指令模型和两套生成语料。两者都恢复出 valence 几何，PC1 与 valence 的最高相关系数分别为 r=0.76 和 r=0.83，接近 Claude 上报告的 r=0.81。层深分析显示 Gemma 早层强编码 valence、后层衰减，Apertus 则早层缺失、中层以后出现；arousal 编码对抽取语料更敏感。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether emotion vectors reported in Claude Sonnet 4.5 also appear in open-weight instruction models with similar representational geometry.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic replication and comparison study. Its useful contribution is not a new training method, but evidence about how affective concepts are represented differently across model families and depths.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors extract emotion contrast vectors across layers in Apertus-8B-Instruct-2509 and Gemma-4-E4B-it, using two model-generated corpora, then analyze whether the resulting directions align with psychological dimensions such as valence and arousal.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates two open-weight instruction models. Both recover a valence geometry, with peak PC1-valence correlations of r=0.76 and r=0.83, close to the r=0.81 reported for Claude. The depth profiles differ: Gemma encodes valence strongly in early layers and loses it later, while Apertus shows the opposite pattern; arousal is more corpus-sensitive.

recommendation.zh: 作为机制备查即可；层深差异比“情绪向量存在”更有信息量，但 setup 还不足以推到训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Keep it as mechanism background; the depth-profile mismatch is more useful than the replication, but it is not yet actionable for pretraining.

paper.title: Skin-Deep: A Geometric Diagnostic for Alignment Fragility in Large Language Model Representations
paper.abstract: Alignment tuning is meant to make harmful-request refusal robust, yet this safety behavior can be erased by a small set of benign fine-tuning examples. This is a deployment risk for open-weight models because a checkpoint can pass refusal tests at release time and later lose refusal under low-cost downstream fine-tuning. Prior work has established these refusal failures, but existing studies do not show how to detect this fragility in the aligned model itself before an attack or fine-tuning inte

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文想在攻击或微调发生之前，诊断一个已对齐模型的拒答行为是否脆弱。它关注的不是模型当前是否能拒绝有害请求，而是拒答机制是否只依赖少量容易被扰动的隐藏状态方向；如果是，少量 benign fine-tuning、LoRA 或提示扰动就可能擦除安全行为。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练 recipe，而在表示分析和 post-train 质量诊断。它给出一个可提前计算的几何指标 GFS，用来压缩 layer-wise safety geometry。对开源权重模型尤其相关：一个 checkpoint 发布时可能通过拒答测试，但下游用少量普通样本微调后拒答能力下降。这个工作提示，安全评测不能只看行为结果，还要看拒答信号在残差流中的维度、层位置和因果性。对于研究 pretrain 到 posttrain 接口的人，它提供了一个分析 alignment 是否只是薄层覆盖的工具。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 Skin-Deep。给定一个 aligned model M 和对应 base model M0，作者在有害请求集合 D_safe 与长度匹配的 benign instruction 集合 D_gen 上抽取每层 final-token residual-stream activation。第一步用 contrastive PCA 寻找能够区分 harmful request 与 benign instruction 的候选方向，比较 aligned 与 base activation 的协方差结构。第二步用 Cohen’s d 衡量投影后两类样本的分离强度，并用 PERMANOVA 和 RBF-kernel MMD 检查这种分离是否也存在于 full-space，而不是只在单一投影上成立。第三步做控制实验，包括单位范数 PCA，排除激活范数差异造成的假信号；同时测量与 Arditi refusal direction 的余弦相似度，确认恢复出的方向不只是已有 refusal axis 的重复。第四步在生成时 ablate 选中的 peak-layer direction，并与随机方向对照，验证这些方向是否因果影响拒答。最后把层级几何模式压缩为 Geometric Fragility Score，用于在任何 LoRA 或攻击运行前预测对齐脆弱性。
summary.experiments: 实验池包含 21 个模型，覆盖 6 种对齐 recipe，参数规模从 3B 到 32B。主要结论有四类。第一，harmful request 与 benign instruction 在多个模型中沿少量隐藏状态方向可分；split-sample 检查显示，层选择在 held-out prompt 上仍然成立。第二，full-space PERMANOVA 和 MMD 支持这种分离不是一维投影偶然结果；单位范数控制说明信号不能简单解释为 harmful prompt 激活范数更大。第三，对 peak-layer 候选方向做 ablation 会削弱部分模型的拒答行为，而随机方向不会产生同样效果，说明几何方向与行为有因果联系。第四，不同模型家族中相同 prompt 之间的 activation relationship 有相似性，但最强 harmful/general 分离层不同，说明它不是所有模型在同一深度出现的固定模式。LoRA 实验中，GFS 能识别出在小规模 LoRA 微调后仍保留更多拒答的初始安全模型。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–40 分钟。先看 Sec. 3 的 Geometric Fragility 定义，重点理解 cPCA、Cohen’s d、direction ablation 和 GFS 各自承担的角色，避免把相关性诊断和因果测试混在一起。然后看 Sec. 5.1 的 subspace 与控制实验，判断信号是否可能来自 prompt 格式、长度或 activation norm。Sec. 5.2 是核心，因为方向 ablation 才把几何分离和拒答行为连接起来。Sec. 5.4 的 LoRA 结果适合快速看 GFS 是否有实际诊断价值。若时间有限，优先看方法图、GFS 公式、peak-layer ablation 表，以及 LoRA fragility 对比图。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether refusal fragility can be detected in an aligned model before any jailbreak, prompt attack, or fine-tuning intervention is performed. The target is not current refusal accuracy, but whether refusal is carried by a small set of hidden-state directions that can be disrupted by benign fine-tuning, LoRA updates, or prompt-level perturbations.
summary_en.importance: The main value is in representation-level auditing rather than pretraining recipe design. The proposed Geometric Fragility Score gives a pre-intervention diagnostic for whether alignment behavior is thinly encoded in the residual stream. This matters for open-weight deployment: a model may pass refusal tests at release time and later lose refusal after low-cost downstream fine-tuning. For researchers studying the interface between pretraining and post-training, the paper provides a way to inspect whether alignment has created a stable behavioral mechanism or a low-dimensional overlay that is easy to erase.
summary_en.technical_approach: Skin-Deep compares an aligned model M with its base counterpart M0. For harmful-request prompts and length-matched benign instructions, it extracts final-token residual-stream activations at each layer. It first uses contrastive PCA to find candidate directions that separate harmful requests from benign instructions by comparing activation covariance in the aligned and base models. It then measures separation with Cohen’s d. PERMANOVA and RBF-kernel MMD are used as full-space validation checks, so the signal is not only a one-dimensional projection artifact. Additional controls include PCA on unit-normalized activations to rule out pure norm effects and cosine comparison with the Arditi refusal direction to test whether the recovered directions collapse to a known refusal axis. The causal step is direction ablation during generation: selected peak-layer directions are removed and compared with random-direction controls. The layer-wise pattern is then compressed into the Geometric Fragility Score, computed before the tested LoRA or attack intervention is run.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates 21 models across six alignment recipes, with sizes from 3B to 32B. The main empirical findings are: harmful and benign prompts separate along a small number of hidden-state directions; split-sample checks show that layer selection transfers to held-out prompts; full-space PERMANOVA and MMD support that the split is not merely a projection artifact; unit-norm controls reduce the chance that the signal is just activation magnitude. Direction ablation weakens refusal in models where a measurable drop is available, while random controls do not show the same effect. The refusal-changing directions differ by model, suggesting model-specific directions inside a recurring low-rank safety geometry rather than one universal refusal vector. Cross-family checks show similar activation relationships among the same prompts, but the strongest harmful/general separation appears at different layers. In the LoRA experiment, GFS identifies the initially safe model that retains the most refusal under the small-scale LoRA protocol.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–40 minutes. Start with the geometric-fragility setup to understand the roles of cPCA, Cohen’s d, full-space tests, direction ablation, and GFS. The most important empirical section is the ablation study, because it connects the discovered directions to refusal behavior rather than prompt-category separation alone. The control experiments are also worth checking: unit-normalized PCA, prompt-format controls, and comparison to the known refusal direction. For practical use, focus on the GFS definition and the LoRA experiment, since these parts determine whether the diagnostic can flag fragile alignment before an intervention is run.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫正文实验：若 GFS 真的能预测微调后拒答坍塌，内部安全评测应加入这类几何探针。
recommendation.en: Skim the experiments: if GFS predicts refusal collapse after fine-tuning, internal safety evals should add this class of geometric probe.

paper.title: GEMS: Geometric Constraints Enable Multi-Semantic Superposition in LLMs
paper.abstract: Activation steering controls model behavior by modifying intermediate hidden states at inference time without retraining. Existing methods handle only single-direction injection; when multiple semantic directions are superposed without constraints, the model collapses. We show that this collapse decomposes into two independently acting sources: distributional deviation, where additive perturbations accumulate in norm across layers and drive activations outside the training distribution, and dire

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是多语义 activation steering 的稳定性问题。单个 steering direction 往往能工作，但多个语义方向同时注入时，模型输出容易退化。作者把退化拆成两个相对独立的来源：一是激活范数逐层累积，导致 hidden state 偏离训练分布；二是不同语义向量不正交，叠加后互相削弱或串扰。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在训练 recipe，而在表征几何和可控生成机制。它给 activation steering 的失败模式提供了较清楚的诊断框架：多方向控制不是简单把多个向量相加，而要同时控制范数稳定性和方向可分性。这个结论对理解 LLM hidden space 的 superposition、特征干涉、层间分布漂移有启发。作为方法，GEMS 仍是 inference-time intervention，不改变权重，因此更适合作为机制分析和数据合成工具，而不是基座训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: GEMS 是一个 training-free 的多方向 steering 方法。核心做法不是学习新的投影或分类器，而是在前向传播中加入几何约束。第一，做 norm preservation，避免多个 steering vector 叠加后把激活推到训练分布之外。第二，选择 o_proj 注入点，作者认为这是稳定注入的关键位置；在该位置之外注入更容易导致退化。第三，对多个语义方向做正交化，降低 directional interference。第四，用 Gaussian envelope 在连续多层上分配干预强度，而不是只在单层或少数层注入；这个设计对应了语义信息分布在多层的观察。和 ActAdd、CAA、RepE、ITI 相比，GEMS 的重点从单方向控制转到多方向并行控制；和 MSRS、MAT-STEER、K-Steering 相比，它不引入额外训练过程。
summary.experiments: 实验主线是诊断和消融。作者在 Qwen3.5-4B-Base 上分析多方向 steering collapse，并把失败归因到 distributional deviation 和 directional interference。GEMS 能在 dense model 的 10 层以上连续层中并行注入多个语义方向。关键消融结论是：去掉 norm preservation 或不在 o_proj 注入会导致明显退化；不做正交化时，输出更容易出现语义漂移；Gaussian envelope 用来缓和不同层的干预强度差异。文中还给出 3B 到 31B 模型上的定性迁移结果，说明该几何约束可能不强依赖单一模型架构。提供内容中没有足够完整的量化表格和具体分数，因此不宜把结论解读为稳定的跨模型性能保证。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。建议先看 Introduction 中对两个 failure modes 的定义，再看 Motivation 中关于层间分布式语义存储的论证。方法部分重点看四个设计：norm preservation、o_proj injection、orthogonalization、Gaussian envelope。实验部分重点看消融：哪些约束是必要条件，哪些只是提升稳定性的调节项。值得深挖的是作者如何度量“偏离训练分布”和“方向干涉”，因为这决定了该方法能否从经验技巧变成更通用的 hidden-state 控制原则。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why multi-direction activation steering breaks down. Single-vector steering can often shift model behavior, but adding several semantic directions at once tends to degrade generation. The authors decompose the failure into two sources: norm-level distributional deviation, where repeated additive perturbations push hidden states away from the training distribution, and directional interference, where non-orthogonal semantic vectors suppress or distort one another.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model research is mechanistic rather than pretraining procedural. It provides a useful diagnosis of hidden-space control: multi-attribute steering is not just vector addition, because both activation-scale stability and geometric separability matter. This connects to superposition, feature interference, and layer-wise representation drift. GEMS is an inference-time method, so its immediate use is more likely in model analysis, controlled generation, and structured data synthesis than in base-model training itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: GEMS is a training-free geometric intervention method. It keeps the intervention within a stable norm range, injects at the o_proj location, orthogonalizes semantic directions to reduce interference, and distributes intervention strength over consecutive layers with a Gaussian envelope. The design follows the observation that semantic information is spread across layers, making single-layer steering brittle. Compared with ActAdd, CAA, RepE, and ITI, the shift is from single-attribute control to parallel multi-attribute control. Compared with learned multi-steering methods such as MSRS, MAT-STEER, and K-Steering, GEMS avoids additional optimization or architecture changes.
summary_en.experiments: The diagnostic analysis is conducted on Qwen3.5-4B-Base. The paper reports that multi-direction collapse can be separated into distributional deviation and directional interference, and that GEMS can inject multiple semantic directions across more than 10 consecutive layers in dense models. The key ablations are qualitative but informative: removing norm preservation or moving away from the o_proj injection point leads to immediate collapse; removing orthogonalization causes semantic drift; the Gaussian envelope helps allocate intervention strength across layers. The paper also reports preliminary qualitative transfer across models from 3B to 31B. The provided text does not contain enough complete quantitative tables, so the results should be read as evidence for a design principle rather than a fully established scaling claim.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, about 20 to 30 minutes. Read the introduction for the two failure modes, then the motivation section for the argument that steering should be distributed across layers. In the method section, focus on norm preservation, o_proj injection, orthogonalization, and the Gaussian envelope. In the experiments, the most useful parts are the ablations showing which constraints are necessary. The main point worth checking carefully is how the paper measures distributional deviation and directional interference, since those measurements determine whether the method generalizes beyond the shown settings.

recommendation.zh: 读机制分解即可：norm drift 与方向干扰这个拆法干净，效果表若 setup 小就别过度外推。
recommendation.en: Read the failure decomposition: norm drift plus directional interference is a clean framing, but do not over-extrapolate if the setups are small.

paper.title: When Language Representations Interact: Separability and Cross-Lingual Effects in LLMs
paper.abstract: Large language models exhibit strong multilingual capabilities, however, their internal representations are difficult to interpret. Understanding these interactions is important for ensuring reliable behavior in multilingual systems. Recent work has shown that causal-geometric structure can explain how certain concepts are encoded as approximately linear and separable directions, but whether this framework extends to multilingual models, where language identity is correlated and hierarchical, is

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究多语言 LLM 内部的语言身份表示是否可以被近似看成独立、可干预的线性概念，还是与语系、文字、训练数据相关性等因素纠缠在一起。核心问题不是提升多语言性能，而是判断语言方向的几何可分性，以及这种可分性对跨语言 steering 和安全机制是否可靠。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的启发主要在机制分析和多语言表示诊断。许多安全过滤、监控或 steering 方法默认概念方向可以独立干预，但多语言场景天然存在相关性：相近语种共享词形、语法、文字系统和训练分布。论文的价值在于把“语言相似”与“因果可分”区分开，提醒预训练研究者在评估 multilingual capability 时不能只看任务准确率或 embedding similarity，还要看干预是否会外溢到相关语言。它不是预训练方法论文，贡献更偏解释性评测工具和表示分析。
summary.technical_approach: 方法基于 causal–geometric interpretability。论文把语言身份视作一个概念变量，用双语 contrast 构造表示空间中的差分方向，例如 English→French。若一组 counterfactual pair 的差分向量在不同样本上近似平行，就说明该语言 contrast 有稳定线性方向。为了区分真实依赖和表示空间尺度造成的伪相关，论文使用 covariance-adjusted 或 causal inner product：它会重标定表示空间，使独立概念方向更接近正交。随后作者分析 28 个双语 contrast 和 3 个非语言概念，在 embedding/context space 和 unembedding/logit space 中检查方向稳定性、方向重叠、语系结构以及干预效果。加性干预用于诊断：沿某个语言方向移动 hidden state，观察 logit 和最终生成是否按预期变化。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen3-4B、Mistral-7B-v0.3 和 Llama-3-8B，分析 28 个双语语言对比和 3 个非语言概念。主要发现有四点。第一，许多双语 contrast 能形成稳定、近似线性的方向，并能泛化到估计样本之外。第二，使用协方差校正后的内积会降低语言方向之间的表观重叠，使残余重叠更接近语言相似性而非尺度噪声。第三，同一语系内部的语言方向呈现 simplex-like organization，说明模型表示中存在层级化语言结构。第四，加性干预在 logit 层面有系统性影响，但对完整生成的控制有限，说明线性 steering 可以作为诊断工具，但不应直接等同于可靠的多语言行为控制。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 15–25 分钟。优先看 Methodology 中 causal inner product 的定义和 bilingual contrast 的构造方式；再看表示方向稳定性、方向重叠矩阵和语系 simplex-like structure 的图。干预实验也值得看，但应按诊断实验理解，不要把它当作完整 steering 方法。对预训练研究者，最有用的问题是：不同训练语料配比、共享 tokenizer、脚本重叠和低资源语言数据量，是否会改变这些语言方向的可分性和残余耦合。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether language identity inside multilingual LLMs behaves like an approximately independent, linearly intervenable concept, or whether it remains entangled with language family, script, lexical overlap, and training-data correlations. The goal is interpretability and controllability analysis, not improving multilingual benchmark scores.
summary_en.importance: The work is most useful as a representation diagnostic for multilingual base models. Many monitoring, filtering, and steering methods assume that high-level concepts can be isolated by directions in activation space. Multilingual models are a hard case for that assumption because languages are correlated in structured ways. The paper separates two questions that are often conflated: whether language representations are similar, and whether language identity is causally separable enough for targeted intervention. For pretraining research, this suggests that multilingual evaluation should include representation coupling and cross-lingual spillover, not only downstream accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis follows a causal-geometric interpretability framework. A language is treated as a concept variable, and a bilingual contrast such as English-to-French is represented by activation differences between paired examples. If those differences are approximately parallel across examples, the contrast is considered to have a stable linear direction. The paper then uses a covariance-adjusted or causal inner product to rescale representation space so that independent concepts should become closer to orthogonal. This makes residual overlap more interpretable as structured dependence rather than an artifact of activation scale. The study covers 28 bilingual contrasts and 3 non-linguistic concepts across embedding/context and unembedding/logit-related spaces. Additive interventions along language directions are used as diagnostics for whether these directions produce predictable logit and generation effects.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments analyze Qwen3-4B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, and Llama-3-8B. The main findings are consistent across the setup. Many bilingual contrasts yield stable, approximately linear directions that generalize beyond the examples used to estimate them. The covariance-adjusted inner product reduces apparent overlap between language directions, making the remaining structure align better with linguistic similarity. Languages from the same family show simplex-like organization, suggesting that hierarchical language relations are reflected geometrically. Additive interventions produce systematic logit-level changes, but generation-level control is limited. This gap is important: a direction can be useful for diagnosis without being sufficient for reliable steering.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 15–25 minute skim should focus on the methodology for constructing bilingual contrast directions and defining the causal inner product. Then inspect the plots or tables for direction stability, overlap under the adjusted inner product, and family-level simplex-like structure. The intervention section is useful, but it should be read as a limitation study for linear steering rather than as a control method. For pretraining researchers, the most interesting extension is to connect these separability patterns to tokenizer sharing, corpus mixture, script overlap, and low-resource language exposure.

recommendation.zh: 把“线性可分离概念”这套工具搬到多语上，能直接指导你做跨语干预/去偏；但更像诊断学，别期待给出可落地的训练改法。
recommendation.en: A clean extension of linear-separability tooling to multilingual factors—useful for cross-lingual intervention/debugging, but it’s mostly diagnostics, not a training recipe.

paper.title: Rotate2Think: Geometric Priming via Orthogonal Rotation to Improve Language Model Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reasoning models achieve strong performance on challenging tasks by generating explicit intermediate reasoning traces before producing a final answer. Yet the internal structure of representation space when reasoning remains poorly understood: how do a model's hidden representations differ during thinking versus the embeddings of the input prompt, and can this structure be exploited to elicit stronger reasoning at inference time? We show that both input embeddings and thinking embeddings (mean-p

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题不是“怎样让模型多想一步”，而是更具体的一件事：推理模型在进入 <think> 轨道时，隐藏表示是否会切换到一个稳定但与输入提示不同的几何区域；如果会，能否在不训练模型、不增加采样轮数的前提下，把新问题的表示直接推到这个区域里，从而改善后续推理。作者把问题落到表示几何上：比较 prompt 的输入表示与 reasoning trace 的 thinking 表示，考察二者的方向结构、可对齐性，以及这种结构是否是模型内生的而不是数据集特有的。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要有两层。第一，它给“推理模式”和“普通生成模式”的差异提供了一个可操作的表示层解释：两类表示都高度锥化，几乎沿单一主方向聚集，但二者主方向并不重合，因此从输入到思维的切换可以近似看成一个低复杂度的正交变换问题。这个观察对理解 CoT、reasoning token、以及 post-train 后模型内部状态如何改变有直接价值。第二，它提出的 Rotate2Think 是一种训练外、推理时的表示注入方法：不改权重，只拟合一个 D×D 旋转矩阵，再把合成的 thinking 向量插到 <think> 与 </think> 之间。对预训练研究员来说，这件事的启发不在于它替代训练，而在于它提示“推理能力的一部分可能是可几何启动的”，也就是 post-train 学到的并不全是复杂策略，可能还包括进入某种表示子空间的门控机制。量级上，它更像一个有意思的机制性发现加一个轻量方法，而不是通用范式替换。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三步。第一步是定义两类表示。对每个问题 q，作者取一次仅前向的 prompt 最后一层隐藏状态并做 mean pooling，得到输入表示 e_in(q)；再让模型生成带 <think>…</think> 的推理轨迹，对 think span 内最后一层隐藏状态做 mean pooling，得到 thinking 表示 e_th(q)。第二步是做几何诊断。作者发现，不同模型、不同任务上，这两组向量都具有极高 conicity，也就是样本几乎都贴着各自的均值方向；但输入均值方向 μ_in 与 thinking 均值方向 μ_th 明显失配，文中给出的跨模型跨基准平均余弦约 0.66，而各自空间内部与均值的相似度接近 1。这个结构意味着：虽然两个空间都近似一维锥体，但轴线不同，因此从输入到思维的映射可以近似为旋转。第三步是拟合并注入。作者用一小批“模型已正确解出”的样本，构造输入表示矩阵与 thinking 表示矩阵，通过 orthogonal Procrustes 求一个闭式正交矩阵 R，使 R e_in 尽量逼近 e_th。推理时，对新问题先算 e_in(q)，再得到合成向量 ê_th(q)=R e_in(q)，并通过 inputs_embeds 接口把它作为单个 token 位置插入 <think> 与 </think> 之间，作为 reasoning trace 的几何起点。这里有两个值得注意的设计取舍：一是只用正交变换，不做仿射或非线性映射，目的是把假设压到最简单，避免把效果混成一个小型适配器；二是训练集不来自目标 benchmark，而来自 held-out 正确样本，强调它学的是模型几何而不是任务模板。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖四个模型家族、参数规模约 4B 到 31B，并在数学、科学、代码等文本推理基准上测试。几何层面，作者报告旋转后对 thinking 表示的重建余弦相似度普遍大于 0.96，均方误差小于 0.05，说明“输入→思维”确实可以被一个单矩阵高保真近似。效果层面，Rotate2Think 在 32 个 model-benchmark 组合中的 30 个上带来提升，说明它不是只对单一模型或单一任务有效。摘要里没有给出每个 benchmark 的完整数字，但明确提到一个较强的跨模态结果：旋转矩阵完全在文本推理数据上拟合，却能零样本迁移到视觉数学推理 MATH-Vision(testmini)；在 Gemma-4 E4B 上，Base+R2T 达到 38.1%，超过该模型完整 reasoning mode 的 34.9%。这说明它注入的不是某个文本任务模板，而更像是模型内部“进入思维态”的方向信号。按全文描述，作者还做了跨数据集拟合与泛化，强调不需要目标分布样本即可工作。若精读实验部分，建议重点看：不同层、不同 pooling 方式是否稳健；正确样本数量对旋转拟合的敏感性；以及 reasoning model 与 base model 上收益是否有系统差异。这些决定了它究竟是在补 reasoning head，还是在更普遍地激活一种推理轨道。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合按“现象—假设—闭式方法—泛化验证”的顺序读。先看引言和几何分析部分，抓住两个核心统计量：within-space conicity 很高，以及 μ_in 与 μ_th 的失配。没有这两个现象，后面的 Procrustes 旋转就站不住。然后看方法部分，确认作者到底注入了什么：不是额外文本提示，也不是多 token prefix，而是一个由输入表示旋转得到的单位置 embedding。再看主实验表，重点判断三件事：一，收益是否稳定而不是少数任务拉高均值；二，base model 与 reasoning model 谁更受益；三，跨模态迁移是否真的支持“这是模型属性而非数据属性”。如果时间有限，优先看几何可视化、重建误差表、32 组配置的主结果表，以及 MATH-Vision 的零样本迁移结果。预计 35–50 分钟可以抓住主线；若要深挖，值得继续想两个问题：为什么最后一层 mean pooling 足够；以及这种旋转是否可以在预训练或 mid-train 中被显式正则化，让模型更容易进入 reasoning subspace。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise question about reasoning geometry: when a model enters a <think> span, do its hidden representations move into a stable region that is geometrically distinct from the prompt representation, and if so, can we place a new query directly into that region without retraining the model or spending extra test-time compute? The goal is not to generate longer chains of thought, but to identify whether the onset of reasoning has a reproducible representational signature that can be exploited at inference time.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining and foundation-model research is mainly interpretive, with a lightweight method attached. First, it gives a concrete geometric account of the difference between prompt processing and reasoning-mode generation: both input embeddings and thinking embeddings are highly conic, but their dominant directions are misaligned. That turns the prompt-to-thinking transition into something close to a low-complexity rotation problem. This is useful for understanding what post-training may be doing internally when it teaches a model to emit reasoning traces. Second, Rotate2Think suggests that part of reasoning behavior may be triggered by entering the right representational subspace, not only by learning a richer decoding policy. That does not replace training, but it does sharpen the question of whether reasoning post-training partly acts as a state-space reconfiguration mechanism.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three stages. First, the authors define two pooled representations for each query q. The input embedding e_in(q) is obtained by running the prompt once and mean-pooling the final-layer hidden states over the prompt tokens. The thinking embedding e_th(q) is obtained by generating a reasoning trace and mean-pooling the final-layer hidden states over the <think>...</think> span. Second, they analyze the geometry of these two sets. Across models and benchmarks, both sets show extreme conicity: vectors cluster tightly around a single mean direction. However, the mean input direction mu_in and the mean thinking direction mu_th are not aligned; the paper reports an average cosine of about 0.66 across tested settings, while within-space alignment is much closer to 1. This combination of near-one-dimensional structure plus cross-space misalignment motivates an orthogonal mapping. Third, they fit an orthogonal Procrustes transform R on a small set of correctly solved examples, minimizing the discrepancy between R e_in and e_th. At inference time, they compute e_in for a new query, form a synthetic thinking vector e_hat_th = R e_in, and inject it as a single embedding position between <think> and </think> through the inputs_embeds interface. Two design choices matter here. They restrict the map to be orthogonal rather than affine or nonlinear, which keeps the hypothesis sharp and avoids hiding capacity in an adapter. And they fit R on held-out solved examples rather than target-benchmark data, aiming to capture model geometry rather than task-specific prompting patterns.
summary_en.experiments: The study spans four model families, roughly 4B to 31B parameters, and benchmarks in math, science, and code reasoning. On the geometry side, the fitted rotation reconstructs thinking embeddings with cosine similarity above 0.96 and mean squared error below 0.05 across tested settings, which is strong evidence that the prompt-to-thinking transition is well approximated by a single matrix. On downstream accuracy, Rotate2Think improves 30 out of 32 model-benchmark combinations, indicating that the effect is not confined to one architecture or one task family. The most striking transfer result is cross-modal: a rotation fitted only on text reasoning transfers zero-shot to visual math reasoning on MATH-Vision (testmini). For Gemma-4 E4B, Base+R2T reaches 38.1%, exceeding the model’s full reasoning-mode accuracy of 34.9% on a modality never seen during fitting. That result supports the claim that the learned transform reflects a model-internal reasoning geometry rather than a dataset-specific textual template. When reading the experimental section closely, the most informative details are likely the sensitivity to the number of solved examples used for fitting, robustness to pooling and layer choices, and whether gains differ systematically between base models and already-reasoning-tuned models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it in the order phenomenon, hypothesis, closed-form method, then transfer. Start with the geometric analysis and make sure the two empirical facts are convincing: very high within-space conicity, and clear misalignment between the input and thinking mean directions. Without those, the Procrustes formulation is not compelling. Then inspect the method section carefully: the intervention is not an extra textual prefix and not a learned adapter, but a single injected embedding derived from the query representation. In the results, focus on three questions. Are gains broad or driven by a few tasks? Do base models benefit more than reasoning models? Does the cross-modal transfer really support the claim that the geometry is model-specific rather than data-specific? If time is limited, prioritize the geometry figures, the reconstruction metrics, the main 32-setting results table, and the MATH-Vision transfer result. A careful first pass should take about 35 to 50 minutes. For deeper follow-up, the most interesting open questions are why final-layer mean pooling is sufficient, and whether this kind of rotation could be encouraged during pretraining or mid-training as an explicit reasoning-state regularizer.

recommendation.zh: 表征几何的观测非常扎实，推理时零成本干预的思路有启发，重点看§3的表征几何分析部分即可
recommendation.en: The geometric observations of representations are solid; the zero-cost inference-time intervention is inspiring, focus on §3's representation geometry analysis.

paper.title: Integrating Local and Global Entropy for Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs
paper.abstract: Large language models hallucinate confidently, making uncertainty quantification (UQ) essential for reliable deployment. Existing methods rely predominantly on token-level signals, leaving the geometric structure of intermediate hidden states underused. In this paper, we take the geometric complexity of hidden-state matrices as a measure of the global uncertainty of LLMs, while treating token-level uncertainty estimation as a local metric. We show that hidden-state geometric entropy (global unce

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是 LLM 不确定性估计里一个很具体的缺口：仅靠 token-level entropy 往往抓不住“答得很自信但其实错了”的情形，因为 logits 只反映下一 token 分布是否尖锐，不反映生成过程中内部表示是否在语义空间里漂移。作者想找一个单次前向、无监督、长度归一、架构无关的补充信号，用隐藏状态轨迹的几何复杂度来刻画这种全局不确定性，并与局部 token 熵结合。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响不如训练目标或数据方法那样大，但它对训练动态分析、表征诊断和可靠性建模有启发。关键贡献不是又提出一个校准分数，而是把不确定性拆成两个结构上不同的层面：unembedding 空间里的局部不确定性，以及 hidden-state trajectory 里的全局几何不确定性。这个拆分对理解“为什么模型会流畅地胡说”很有帮助，也给预训练阶段的表示质量分析提供了一个可复用工具。若把它往基座研究上延伸，可以用来监控不同数据配比、不同训练阶段、不同 post-train 配方对表示轨迹紧致性的影响。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 GLU（Global-Local Uncertainty）。局部部分沿用常见的 token-level 不确定性，文中比较了 Shannon entropy 以及 evidential epistemic entropy 等变体，并做长度归一。全局部分则从生成序列的隐藏状态矩阵 H 出发：把某一层或最终层在每个生成步的 hidden state 堆成 T×d 的轨迹矩阵，再构造 Gram matrix K=HH^T，用其特征值分布计算矩阵 Rényi entropy，作为几何复杂度指标。直觉上，如果模型在生成时沿少数稳定语义方向推进，K 会更低秩，谱更集中，几何熵更低；如果模型缺乏可靠依据，隐藏状态会在多个方向上游走，谱更分散，几何熵更高。作者强调这与 token entropy 处在不同表示层：后者在输出概率空间，前者在语义方向空间，因此二者不应被视为冗余信号。组合方式上，作者比较了加法与乘法融合，发现乘法更稳定，因而定义 GLU 为全局与局部不确定性的乘性融合。全文还讨论了层选择问题，并引用相关工作说明中间层有时比最终层更富信息；不过从给出的公式和实验描述看，主实现仍以标准生成过程中可直接提取的隐藏状态轨迹为主，不需要额外采样或监督训练。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个模型家族、六个 benchmark。作者首先验证两个信号的统计关系：global geometry 与 local token entropy 近似正交，说明它们确实覆盖不同失败模式，而不是同一信号的不同缩放。更具体地，错误样本中有一部分落在“低 token entropy 但高 geometric entropy”的区域，这正是传统 logit-based 方法容易漏掉的 confident-but-wrong。主结果显示，GLU 的乘法融合在可靠性预测上系统优于单独使用局部或全局信号，也优于加法融合。摘要片段没有给出完整数值表，因此无法在这里准确复述 AUROC、AUPRC 或 calibration 指标的具体提升幅度；但从全文叙述看，作者做了较完整的消融，包括：不同局部熵定义、不同全局几何熵定义、不同层、长度归一处理，以及单次前向约束下的效率比较。阅读时要特别留意一个问题：几何熵是否只是 response length、topic diversity 或 verbosity 的代理变量。作者声称方法做了长度归一，并通过消融说明它不是简单的长度效应，这一点决定了方法是否真的测到“语义漂移”。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇更适合带着“诊断工具”视角去读，而不是把它当成新的训练方法。先看引言和方法定义，弄清 global 与 local 分别测什么，以及为什么作者坚持单次前向、无监督、长度归一这三个约束。然后看几何熵的定义部分，重点确认 Rényi entropy 是如何从 Gram matrix 谱上计算出来的，是否对层、序列长度、hidden norm 做了规范化。实验部分优先看两类图：一类是 global 与 local 的二维散点或分桶图，用来证明 confident-but-wrong 的恢复；另一类是融合方式和 estimator 选择的消融。若时间有限，20–30 分钟足够抓住主结论。若要深挖，建议继续想三件事：一，这个几何指标在预训练中是否能作为 online 监控信号；二，它与 loss spike、数据脏度、重复数据是否相关；三，它能否反过来指导 decoding 或 refusal 策略，而不只是做事后打分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific weakness in LLM uncertainty estimation: token-level entropy often misses the confident-but-wrong regime because sharp next-token distributions do not imply that the model is following a stable semantic trajectory internally. The authors look for a complementary signal that is unsupervised, single-pass, length-normalized, and architecture-agnostic, using the geometry of hidden-state trajectories to capture a more global form of uncertainty.
summary_en.importance: Its direct impact on pretraining is modest compared with work on objectives, data, or optimization, but it is useful as a representation-level diagnostic. The main contribution is not just another confidence score. It is the decomposition of uncertainty into two structurally different views: local uncertainty in the output distribution, and global uncertainty in the geometry of hidden-state evolution. That framing is relevant to foundation-model research because it offers a way to study why models can produce fluent but weakly grounded answers, and it suggests a reusable probe for comparing training stages, data mixtures, or post-training recipes through the compactness of internal trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed framework is GLU, for Global-Local Uncertainty. The local component is a standard token-level uncertainty measure, with the paper comparing Shannon entropy and evidential epistemic entropy variants under length normalization. The global component is built from the hidden-state trajectory during generation. For a response of length T, the model collects hidden states into a T by d matrix H, forms the Gram matrix K = H H^T, and computes a matrix Rényi entropy from the eigenvalue distribution of K. The intuition is straightforward: when the model is well grounded, hidden states evolve along a small number of coherent semantic directions, making the spectrum concentrated and the geometric entropy low; when the model is uncertain, the trajectory spreads across more directions, producing a flatter spectrum and higher entropy. The authors argue that this signal lives in a different representational layer from token entropy: one is defined in the unembedding space of next-token probabilities, the other in the hidden-state space of semantic directions. They test additive and multiplicative fusion and find multiplicative fusion consistently stronger, which becomes the final GLU score. The method does not require extra sampling, labels, or architectural changes.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers three model families and six benchmarks. A central empirical claim is that global geometric uncertainty and local token entropy are nearly orthogonal statistically, which supports the idea that they capture different failure modes rather than redundant views of the same one. In particular, the paper shows that a nontrivial set of wrong answers lies in the low-token-entropy but high-geometric-entropy region, exactly where logit-only confidence methods tend to fail. The main results indicate that multiplicative GLU outperforms either component alone and also beats additive fusion for reliability prediction. The excerpt provided does not include the full metric tables, so it is not possible to quote exact AUROC or calibration gains here with confidence. Still, the paper appears to include meaningful ablations over the choice of local estimator, the choice of geometric entropy formulation, layer selection, and normalization choices. One question to watch closely while reading is whether geometric entropy is merely a proxy for response length or verbosity. The authors claim to normalize for length and to test this explicitly; that point is important because the method is only interesting if it measures semantic drift rather than superficial sequence statistics.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is best read as a diagnostic paper, not as a new training recipe. Start with the motivation and the formal definitions of global versus local uncertainty, and pay attention to why the authors insist on three constraints: single forward pass, no supervision, and length normalization. Then read the geometric-entropy section carefully and verify how the Rényi entropy is computed from the Gram spectrum, and whether hidden-state norms, layer choice, and sequence length are handled cleanly. In the experiments, prioritize two kinds of figures: plots showing the joint distribution of global and local uncertainty, which support the recovery of confident-but-wrong cases, and ablations comparing fusion rules and estimator variants. A first pass should take about 20 to 30 minutes. For deeper follow-up, the most interesting questions are whether this signal could be monitored during pretraining, whether it correlates with data quality or optimization instability, and whether it can be used not only for post hoc scoring but also to guide decoding or abstention behavior.

recommendation.zh: 全局几何熵捕捉自信错误的发现很有价值，可用于预训练中的幻觉监控，重点看§4的失效模式分析
recommendation.en: The finding that global geometric entropy captures overconfident errors is valuable, can be used for hallucination monitoring during pretraining, focus on §4's failure mode analysis.

paper.title: A Navigable Manifold of Hypothesized Consciousness-Spectrum States in Language Model Representations
paper.abstract: Across contemplative, philosophical, and psychological accounts, human consciousness is often described along a similar spectrum, ranging from reactive and self-focused patterns to more integrative and coherent ones. Understanding whether language models encode such a structured, human-interpretable consciousness spectrum in representation space is important for model guidance, evaluation and alignment. In this work, we study the geometric structure and dynamics of patterns along this spectrum i

summary.core_problem: 人类意识常被描述为从反应性/自我聚焦到整合性/一致性的谱系，但 LLM 表征空间是否编码了这种可解释的意识谱系结构尚不清楚。
summary.importance: 研究 transformer 嵌入空间中意识谱系模式的几何结构和动力学。贡献类型：机制分析 + 表征几何学研究。
summary.technical_approach: 分析句子嵌入的全局几何组织，验证其是否与意识谱系对齐：低级别状态和高级别状态各自聚类为局部连贯区域形成流形；高级别和低级别区域显示类凸稳定性，中间区域形成过渡走廊。动态分析：效用引导和纯几何贪婪轨迹都一致地从低级别向高级别区域穿越。
summary.experiments: 无明确的大规模量化实验或模型规模说明，主要为表征几何分析（摘要被截断）。
summary.authors_note: Sophie Zhao, Georgia Institute of Technology / Cohere

summary_en.core_problem: Human consciousness is often described along a spectrum from reactive/self-focused to integrative/coherent, but it is unknown whether LLM representation spaces encode such a structured, human-interpretable consciousness spectrum.
summary_en.importance: Studies the geometric structure and dynamics of consciousness-spectrum patterns in transformer embedding spaces. Contribution: mechanism analysis + representational geometry investigation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Analyzes the global geometric organization of sentence embeddings to verify alignment with the consciousness spectrum: lower-level and higher-level states cluster into locally coherent regions forming a manifold; high/low regions exhibit convexity-like stability, while intermediate regions form a transition corridor. Dynamically, both utility-guided and geometry-only greedy trajectories consistently traverse from lower- to higher-level regions.
summary_en.experiments: No explicit large-scale quantitative experiments or model scale details provided; primarily representational geometry analysis (abstract truncated).
summary_en.authors_note: Sophie Zhao, Georgia Institute of Technology / Cohere

recommendation.zh: 将意识谱系概念引入 LLM 表征分析，框架新颖但结论的可证伪性弱；对 pretrain 无直接借鉴，仅作为机制分析文献备查。
recommendation.en: Novel framing applying consciousness-spectrum concepts to LLM representation analysis, but claims have weak falsifiability; no direct pretrain implications—keep as interpretability reference.

paper.title: ICA Lens: Interpreting Language Models Without Training Another Dictionary
paper.abstract: Finding interpretable directions in language-model representations is critical for understanding and controlling model behavior. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have become the standard tool for this purpose, but using them as the default first lens often requires training, storing, and evaluating large overcomplete dictionaries. This bottleneck limits rapid exploration and raises a fundamental question: how much interpretable structure is already visible from activation geometry before training anot

summary.core_problem: 研究如何在不额外训练 sparse autoencoder 字典的情况下，从语言模型激活中快速找到可解释方向。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析工具改进。它挑战了“先训练 SAE 再做特征解释”的默认流程，强调激活几何中可能已经有可见的非高斯、token-selective 结构。对预训练研究员的价值不在训练 recipe，而在提供一个低成本的表征诊断入口。
summary.technical_approach: 论文重新引入 independent component analysis，即 ICA，用非高斯性来寻找激活空间中的独立方向。核心假设是：许多可解释方向会对特定 token 或 token 类别有选择性，因此投影分布会偏离随机方向的近似高斯形态。方法定位为 SAE 的轻量替代或前置探针，而不是训练新的过完备神经字典。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可确认的实验设置是对语言模型激活方向做可解释性分析，并与 SAE 作为默认工具的成本和可用性形成对照。摘要未给出模型参数量、具体层数、数据集、定量指标或提升幅度；因此实验可信度需要读正文确认，尤其要看 ICA 稳定性、方向可重复性、与 SAE 特征重合度及人工解释协议。
summary.authors_note: Sida Liu 为 Independent Researcher，Feijiang Han 来自 University of Maryland；未能从给定信息确认更具体的团队代表作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether interpretable directions in language-model activations can be found without training an additional sparse-autoencoder dictionary.
summary_en.importance: This is an interpretability-tooling contribution. It questions the default SAE-first workflow and argues that activation geometry may already expose non-Gaussian, token-selective structure. For pretraining researchers, the value is a cheaper diagnostic lens for representations rather than a new training method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method revisits independent component analysis, using non-Gaussianity to identify directions in activation space. The key assumption is that many interpretable features are selective over tokens or token classes, so their projected activation distributions should deviate from random Gaussian-like projections. ICA is framed as a compact probe or first-pass alternative to training an overcomplete neural dictionary.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates experiments on language-model activations and comparisons against the SAE workflow in terms of cost and usability. It does not specify model sizes, layers, datasets, metrics, or quantitative gains. The main details to verify in the paper are ICA stability, feature reproducibility, overlap with SAE features, and the human interpretation protocol.
summary_en.authors_note: Sida Liu is listed as an Independent Researcher and Feijiang Han is affiliated with the University of Maryland; no additional well-known team background can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 作为 SAE 之外的低成本表征探针值得知道；只看方法和稳定性实验，别把 ICA 当成已验证的 SAE 替代品。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing as a cheap representation probe beyond SAEs; read the method and stability tests, but do not treat ICA as a validated SAE replacement yet.

paper.title: PsychoPass: Geometric Profiling of Multi-Turn Adversarial LLM Conversations
paper.abstract: Multi-turn jailbreak attacks on large language models (LLMs) reveal a mismatch in current guardrails: they operate on individual turns, while attacks unfold as trajectories across conversations. We propose a shift from content to dynamics, modeling conversations as paths in representation space and asking whether adversarial intent is encoded early in their geometry. We introduce PsychoPass, a framework that extracts geometric features from conversation trajectories in embedding space to predict

summary.core_problem: 研究多轮 jailbreak 攻击是否会在对话早期就以“轨迹几何”形式编码在表示空间中，而不仅仅体现在最终有害内容上。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏分析与安全机制研究。它提醒人们：多轮攻击是轨迹问题，不是单轮内容分类问题；同时也较诚实地指出了一个强混杂因素——turn 数本身就能解释大部分效果。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 PsychoPass，把多轮对话映射为 embedding 空间中的路径，提取几何特征来预测对话是否会演化成攻击。实验先发现 naive classifier 近乎完美，但进一步分析表明主要来自 number of turns 这个混杂变量；去除该因素后，仍保留较弱但稳定的几何信号，而且对 encoder 选择不太敏感。还测试了只看短前缀时的可预测性。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体模型和数据规模。核心实验结论是：1）若不控制 turn 数，分类几乎过于容易；2）控制后仍有高于随机的早期信号；3）这种信号在短前缀上更稳定，且对 encoder 选择不敏感。更像是一个安全分析结果，而不是可直接落地的 guardrail 系统。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Indian Institute of Management Bangalore。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks whether multi-turn jailbreak intent is encoded early in the geometry of conversation trajectories in representation space, rather than only in the final harmful content.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an analysis and safety-mechanism paper. It usefully reframes multi-turn attacks as trajectory-level phenomena rather than single-turn content classification, while also honestly surfacing a major confound: turn count explains much of the apparent performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces PsychoPass, which maps multi-turn conversations to paths in embedding space and extracts geometric features to predict whether the dialogue will become adversarial. A key finding is that near-perfect naive classification is largely driven by number of turns; after removing that confound, a weaker but consistent geometric signal remains, and it is not very sensitive to encoder choice. The paper also studies prediction from short prefixes.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model or dataset scales. The main empirical takeaways are: (1) without controlling for turn count, classification is almost trivially easy; (2) after controlling for it, there is still above-chance early signal; and (3) the signal is more reliable from short prefixes and does not depend much on encoder choice. This reads more like a safety analysis result than a deployable guardrail system.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore.

recommendation.zh: 只看混杂分析就够了：它提醒你安全表征论文里“高分”常常是 turn-count 泄漏，不必细读方法，读实验设计与负结果更有价值。
recommendation.en: Read it mainly for the confound analysis: the useful lesson is that many safety-representation wins collapse to turn-count leakage, not for the method itself.

paper.title: Large language models reorganize representational geometry during in-context learning
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit remarkable flexibility: they can adapt to novel tasks from in-context examples without any parameter updates, a capability known as in-context learning (ICL). Prior work on synthetic tasks has shown that ICL can implement specific algorithms, demonstrating architectural competence, and mechanistic analyses have identified key circuits that support this behavior. However, because in-context computation -- regardless of its algorithmic form -- relies on transfo

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是解释预训练 LLM 在 ICL 中为什么有些任务容易、有些任务困难。它把关注点从“模型是否实现了某个在线算法”转到“任务标签在模型内部表示空间里的几何位置是否容易被上下文重组出来”。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在机制分析。它提供了一种减少语义混杂的 ICL 探针：标签不是人工语义类别，而是由模型自身隐藏状态的线性划分生成。这样可以更清楚地观察预训练表示的几何结构如何限制 ICL。结论也比较直接：ICL 不只是提示格式问题，模型已有表示中的高方差方向、类流形可分性、信噪比，会影响上下文学习能否成功。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是构造 representation-defined in-context classification。给定句子集合、目标层和模型，先提取句子级隐藏状态 h_i，再选一个方向 w，用 sign(<w, h_i>) 生成二分类标签。评测时，模型看到若干带标签示例，再预测新句子的标签。关键设计是两类任务轴：一类是 logistic regression 方向，代表模型表示中已经较容易读出的任务相关结构；另一类是 PCA 主成分方向，从高方差到低方差逐步改变任务难度。这个设计避免了常规分类任务中“标签词和语义先验已经在预训练中学过”的问题。随后作者跟踪 ICL 过程中最终层表示的几何变化，包括线性可分性、类流形半径、维度、信噪比，并把模型行为与若干在线学习算法比较。主要发现是，成功 ICL 伴随最终层表示的在线重组，尤其是可分性和信噪比提升；在行为拟合上，原型学习器比更复杂或更接近最优推断的在线算法更吻合，说明模型在这个设置下更像是在压缩上下文证据形成类别摘要。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕不同目标层、不同任务轴和不同数量 in-context examples 展开。最稳定的现象是任务轴的方差等级决定难度：沿高方差 PC 方向定义的标签更容易被学到，低方差方向明显更难。LR 方向作为对照，反映模型已有表示中较强的可读结构。几何分析显示，随着示例增加，成功任务中的最终层表示会变得更容易线性分开，类间信号相对类内噪声增强。算法对照中，prototype-based learner 对模型预测模式的解释力最好，优于把 ICL 简单等同于最优 Bayesian 更新或标准在线梯度学习的解释。给出的材料没有包含完整模型规模、数据集规模和具体数值表，因此不应把该工作理解为大规模性能报告，而应看作一个机制分析框架。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。优先看 Methods 里的 representation-defined task 构造，尤其是标签如何由隐藏状态和任务轴生成；再看 PC 方向从高方差到低方差的难度控制，这是实验设计的核心。结果部分重点看 ICL accuracy 随 PC rank 变化的图、最终层几何指标随上下文示例数变化的图，以及在线学习算法比较表。值得深挖的是两个问题：第一，标签由同一个模型的内部表示生成，是否会偏向证明模型能读出自己已有的几何结构；第二，prototype learner 的拟合结果是否能推广到更自然的语言任务和更长的上下文推理。

summary_en.core_problem: The central question is why pretrained LLMs succeed on some in-context learning tasks and fail on others. The work frames ICL difficulty as a property of the geometry of the model’s own representation space, rather than only as a question of which online algorithm the transformer may implement.
summary_en.importance: The main value is mechanistic. The study introduces an ICL probe that reduces semantic confounding: labels are generated from linear partitions of the model’s hidden states, not from familiar human categories. This makes it easier to study how pretrained representations constrain ICL. The key message is that ICL success depends on where the task lies in representation space. High-variance directions are easier to learn in context, and successful ICL is reflected in increased separability and signal-to-noise ratio in later representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method builds representation-defined binary classification tasks. For a dataset of sentences, a target layer, and a model, sentence-level hidden states are extracted. A task axis w then defines labels by the sign of the inner product between w and each hidden state. At evaluation time, the model receives labeled demonstrations and predicts the label for a new sentence. Two axis families are used. A logistic-regression axis captures a direction already aligned with linearly readable structure in the model’s representations. Principal-component axes create a controlled difficulty sweep from high-variance to low-variance directions. The analysis then measures how final-layer geometry changes during ICL, including separability, manifold radius, dimensionality, and signal-to-noise ratio. Model behavior is compared against online learning baselines. The closest behavioral match is a prototype-style learner, suggesting that the model compresses context into class-level summaries in this setting.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments vary the target layer, the task-defining axis, and the number of in-context examples. The robust pattern is that labels aligned with high-variance PC directions are learned more reliably than labels along low-variance directions. The LR axis serves as a reference for structure that is already linearly accessible in the representation. During successful ICL, final-layer representations become more separable and show improved signal-to-noise structure as more examples are added. Among algorithmic baselines, a prototype-based learner best matches the model’s predictions, more so than interpretations based on near-optimal inference or standard online gradient updates. The provided material does not include complete numerical tables, model sizes, or dataset sizes, so the result should be read as a mechanistic framework rather than a scaling or performance study.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–35 minutes. Start with the construction of representation-defined tasks in the Methods section, especially how labels are induced from hidden states. Then inspect the PC-axis design, since it is the main control knob for task difficulty. In the results, focus on accuracy as a function of PC rank, geometric metrics over the number of demonstrations, and the comparison with online learners. Two points deserve extra attention: whether using the same model to define labels favors tasks already present in its geometry, and whether the prototype-learner interpretation transfers to natural semantic tasks and longer reasoning contexts.

recommendation.zh: 值得看实验设计：它把 ICL 从算法复现拉到表征几何，但需检查因果控制是否足够干净。
recommendation.en: Read for the experimental design: it reframes ICL as representational geometry, but the causal controls need careful inspection.

paper.title: Beyond Temperature: Hyperfitting as a Late-Stage Geometric Expansion
paper.abstract: Recent work has identified a counterintuitive phenomenon termed "Hyperfitting", where fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) to near-zero training loss on small datasets surprisingly enhances open-ended generation quality and mitigates repetition in greedy decoding. While effective, the underlying mechanism remains poorly understood, with the extremely low-entropy output distributions suggesting a potential equivalence to simple temperature scaling. In this work, we demonstrate that this pheno

summary.core_problem: 解释“Hyperfitting”（在极小数据上把训练损失压到接近 0）为何能在贪心解码下显著减少重复、提升开放式生成多样性；并判定它是否只是温度缩放/分布变尖或静态词表偏置的等价物。
summary.importance: 这篇工作把一个看似“反常识”的后期训练现象拆成可检验的机制假设，并给出较强的反证链条：Hyperfitting 的收益不是简单的 entropy 变低，而是发生了上下文相关的 top-1 重新排序。对预训练/中后期训练的启发在于：生成退化（repetition loop）可能更多是“决策边界/表示几何”问题，而不是采样温度问题；同时它暗示了一个更工程化的路径——只在末端层做小范围适配就能改写解码行为，可能成为 cooldown/mid-train 的一个轻量工具。
summary.technical_approach:
全文围绕三个竞争解释做“控制变量 + 反证”：
1) 温度缩放等价假设：如果 Hyperfitting 只是把分布变尖（不改 token 排序），那么通过 temperature 调到同等低熵应能复现多样性提升。作者做了 entropy-matched 对照：把基座模型解码温度调到与 hyperfitted 模型输出熵相当的水平，再比较 TTR/重复率，发现完全复现不了。
2) 静态词表重加权假设：如果只是学到一个全局 logit bias（某些 token 永久升/降权），那可以用“合成注入”的方式把这种 bias 加回去复现效果。作者的 ablation 显示这种静态 reweighting 更像破坏性噪声，不能产生同样的 rank reordering，指向“动态、上下文相关”的重排。
3) 机制定位：作者把 hyperfitting 视为一种 late-stage 的几何扩张（Terminal Expansion）。通过层级分析指出：早期层的语言特征基本保留，关键变化集中在最后一层（或末端少数层）——表示的有效维度显著上升（文中给出 ΔDim ≈ +80.8），从而让长尾候选在特定上下文里被“抬到”top-1，压制局部最优但容易导致循环的高频 token。
在此基础上给出工程化推论：既然变化主要在末端层，就不需要全参 hyperfit。提出 Late-Stage LoRA：只适配最后 5 层即可复现主要的 rank reordering 动力学，作为更省算的替代。
summary.experiments:
复现实验设置清晰：以 TinyLlama-1.1B 做主要机制分析，超饱和训练协议为 2,000 样本、260 epochs、weight decay=0，训练损失趋近 0，同时验证困惑度变差，呈现“likelihood-质量解耦”。
关键对照结果（文中明确给数）：在 entropy-matched 条件下，温度缩放模型的多样性与重复显著劣于 hyperfitted：TTR 约 0.40 vs 0.68；重复指标约 0.60 vs 0.14（对应论文主文 3.2/3.3 的结论）。
泛化性：除 TinyLlama 外，还在 Qwen2.5-1.5B、LLaMA-3.2-3B、Gemma-2-2B 以及更大的 instruct checkpoints（LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）上做验证（细节在附录），用来支持“现象不依赖单一架构/单一 checkpoint”。
机制消融：静态 logit 注入/重加权被证明无法复现，且表现为破坏性噪声（主文 3.5）。
效率实验：Late-Stage LoRA（仅最后 5 层）可在较低改动下复现主要效果（主文 5）。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“假设—对照—定位—工程化”顺序读：
- 先看 Fig.1 的 rank reordering 直觉图，明确作者要证明的不是“更尖”，而是“换赢家”。
- 精读 3.2/3.3：entropy-matched 的设计细节决定了反证力度（如何匹配熵、用什么解码/统计口径）。
- 精读 3.5：静态 bias 注入的构造方式与负结果解释，能帮助判断作者排除了哪些简单替代解释。
- 精读第 4 节：Terminal Expansion 的度量（ΔDim 的定义、如何做层级几何分析）是全文最“可迁移”的方法部分。
- 最后看第 5 节：Late-Stage LoRA 的层选择、是否需要同时改 K/Q/V/MLP、以及与全参 hyperfit 的差距。若要复现或迁移到自家模型，这一节最直接。

summary_en.core_problem: Explain why “hyperfitting” (driving training loss to near-zero on a tiny dataset) can improve open-ended generation under greedy decoding—especially reducing repetition—and determine whether it is merely equivalent to temperature scaling or a static vocabulary bias.
summary_en.importance: The paper turns a puzzling late-stage fine-tuning phenomenon into testable mechanistic hypotheses and provides fairly direct falsification for the two most obvious explanations (entropy sharpening and global logit reweighting). For pretraining/mid-training practice, the key takeaway is that repetition loops can be a representation/decision-boundary issue rather than a decoding-temperature issue, and that the intervention may be localized to late layers—suggesting a lightweight “cooldown-like” adaptation knob (e.g., late-layer LoRA) instead of full-model retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The study is structured as controlled comparisons plus mechanism localization:
- Entropy-matched control against temperature scaling: if hyperfitting only sharpens distributions without changing token ranking, then adjusting temperature to match the hyperfitted model’s low entropy should reproduce the diversity gains. It does not, implying rank changes.
- Falsifying static vocabulary bias: they test whether a global logit bias could explain the effect via synthetic bias injection / reweighting ablations. The injected bias behaves like destructive noise and fails to reproduce the observed behavior, pointing to context-dependent (dynamic) rank reordering.
- Mechanistic localization via geometry: they argue hyperfitting induces a “terminal expansion” concentrated in the final transformer layer(s). Early layers largely preserve linguistic features, while late layers undergo a substantial effective-dimensional expansion (reported ΔDim ≈ +80.8), enabling long-tail candidates to be promoted to top-1 in context and suppressing locally-attractive repetitive tokens.
- Efficiency implication: because the effect is late-layer localized, they propose Late-Stage LoRA—adapting only the last ~5 layers—to recover the rank-reordering dynamics without full-parameter hyperfitting.
summary_en.experiments:
Main mechanistic vehicle: TinyLlama-1.1B with a hyper-saturation recipe (2,000 samples, 260 epochs, no weight decay) reaching near-zero training loss while validation perplexity worsens, demonstrating likelihood–quality decoupling.
Key quantitative evidence (explicit in the paper): under entropy-matched conditions, temperature scaling fails to match hyperfitting on diversity and repetition—TTR ~0.40 vs 0.68 and repetition metric ~0.60 vs 0.14 (sections 3.2/3.3).
Generality checks span multiple base models (Qwen2.5-1.5B, LLaMA-3.2-3B, Gemma-2-2B) and larger instruct checkpoints (LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), with details in appendices.
Ablations: static logit reweighting / synthetic injection fails (section 3.5).
Efficiency: Late-Stage LoRA on the last 5 layers is reported sufficient to reproduce the core behavior (section 5).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read in the order that matches the claim stack:
1) Fig. 1 to internalize the central claim: hyperfitting changes the winner (rank reordering), not just confidence.
2) Sections 3.2–3.3 for the entropy-matched protocol; the exact matching procedure determines how strong the “not temperature” conclusion is.
3) Section 3.5 for the static-bias falsification; focus on how the synthetic bias is constructed and why it degrades.
4) Section 4 for the “terminal expansion” measurement (how ΔDim is defined/estimated and how layerwise localization is done).
5) Section 5 for the practical recipe (which layers, what LoRA targets) if you want to replicate or port the effect.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 entropy-matched control 和最后层分析；若复现实验成立，应重新检查小数据过拟合对 logit 几何的作用。
recommendation.en: Read the entropy-matched controls and final-layer analysis; if reproducible, it forces a recheck of how small-data overfitting reshapes logit geometry.

paper.title: Geometry-Lite: Interpretable Safety Probing via Layer-Wise Margin Geometry
paper.abstract: Prompt-level safety probes for large language models use hidden-state representations to separate safe from unsafe prompts, but strong average detection performance does not explain the geometry of this separation. In particular, it remains unclear how safety evidence is formed across layers, which aspects of that layer-wise geometry support low-false-positive decisions, and which geometric biases remain stable under benchmark shift. We study this as an empirical decomposition problem and introd

summary.core_problem: 解释安全探针在 LLM 隐状态中如何跨层形成 safe/unsafe prompt 的分离边界，而不只报告平均检测分数。
summary.importance: 贡献是安全表征的机制分析和探针方法。它把 prompt-level safety probing 拆成层级 margin geometry，观察哪些几何特征支持低误报、哪些偏置能跨 benchmark 保持稳定。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Geometry-Lite：对每层 final prompt-token representation 分别计算三类 signed margin，包括 centroid readout、local-neighborhood readout 和 supervised linear-boundary readout；再用 boundary position、layer-to-layer change 和 coarse shape 概括跨层 margin profile。
summary.experiments: 覆盖九个 instruction-tuned backbone，参数规模从 1.2B 到 70B，使用七个 safety benchmark。结果显示 Geometry-Lite 优于单层 probe，性能接近直接堆叠多层原始分数，同时提供更可解释的层级几何分解。摘要未给出具体模型清单和数值幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how safety evidence emerges across LLM layers, moving beyond average probe accuracy for safe-versus-unsafe prompt separation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanism-oriented safety probing method. It decomposes prompt-level safety representations into layer-wise margin geometry and studies which geometric features support low false positives and remain stable under benchmark shift.
summary_en.technical_approach: Geometry-Lite maps each layer's final prompt-token representation to signed margins under three readouts: centroid, local-neighborhood, and supervised linear boundary. It then summarizes margin profiles by boundary position, layer-to-layer changes, and coarse profile shape.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers nine instruction-tuned backbones from 1.2B to 70B and seven safety benchmarks. Geometry-Lite improves over single-layer probes and stays close to raw multi-layer score stacking while offering a more interpretable decomposition. The abstract does not list exact model names or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Yonsei University.

recommendation.zh: 读 margin profile 定义和跨 benchmark 稳定性即可；它像诊断工具，不会改训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Read the margin-profile definition and shift-stability results; this is a diagnostic tool, not a recipe-changing training result.

paper.title: Uncovering the Representation Geometry of Minimal Cores in Overcomplete Reasoning Traces
paper.abstract: Language models often generate long chain-of-thought traces, but it remains unclear how much of this reasoning is necessary for preserving the final prediction. We study this through the lens of overcomplete reasoning traces: generated traces that contain more intermediate steps than are needed to support the model's answer. We define the minimal core as the smallest subset of steps that preserves either the final answer or predictive distribution, and introduce metrics for compression ratio, re

summary.core_problem: 论文研究语言模型生成的链式思维（CoT）推理轨迹中，有多少比例的步骤是真正对最终预测必要的。具体定义了'最小核心'（minimal core）——即能保持模型原始预测行为的最小步骤子集——并以此量化推理轨迹的过完备性（overcompleteness），同时探索最小核心的表示几何特性是否比完整轨迹更紧凑、更能区分正确与错误。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有三点：（1）实验发现平均46%的推理步骤是可移除的，这对过程监督（process supervision）的数据策略有直接意义——并非所有中间步骤都值得用相同权重监督；（2）最小核心在不同模型家族间具有可迁移性，说明存在某种跨模型的通用推理结构；（3）最小核心的嵌入表示比完整轨迹更低维、更紧凑、对正确性更有区分度，这为推理能力的评估和压缩提供了新的视角。从预训练数据效率角度看，如果大量推理步骤是冗余的，那么在合成推理训练数据时可以更聚焦。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是将推理轨迹分析转化为子集充分性（subset-sufficiency）问题。给定模型M、输入x和完整轨迹z=(r1,...,rT)，对任意子集S⊆[T]，检查在只保留z_S（按原顺序）时模型的预测是否与完整轨迹时一致。通过贪心删除法（从完整轨迹开始逐次删除对预测影响最小的步骤）提取最小核心，并定义了压缩率、冗余质量、步骤必要性、必要性集中度等度量。论文还给出了最小核心存在性、贪心删除的局部最优性、以及过完备性证书的理论保证。在表示几何方面，分析了完整轨迹、最小核心和被删除步骤的嵌入空间特性（紧致性、正确-错误可分性、内在维度）。
summary.experiments: 在六个推理benchmark（GSM8K, MATH500, AIME24, AMC23, GPQA-Diamond, StrategyQA）上评估，覆盖算术、竞赛数学、专家科学推理、常识多跳QA。跨模型家族的实验发现：贪心最小核心提取平均移除46%的步骤，同时基本保持完整轨迹的答案一致性。预测支持集中在少数步骤上（必要性高度集中）。最小核心可以跨模型家族迁移（从模型A提取的核心在模型B上也能保持预测）。表示几何分析显示：与完整轨迹或被删除步骤的嵌入相比，最小核心的嵌入更紧凑、维度更低、对正确性的区分度更高。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第1章关于过完备推理轨迹的概念框架和研究动机，以及第2章最小核心的形式化定义和度量指标。实验结果（应有第3章）中的冗余比例统计（46%可移除）和必要性集中度分析是核心发现。表示几何部分（应有第4章）从嵌入空间角度提供了额外洞察。建议优先关注：过完备性的量化结果（各benchmark的压缩率）、必要性集中度的可视化、跨模型迁移实验。阅读时间约25-35分钟。
summary.authors_note: 作者信息未在提供的全文内容中标注，无法确认（其中一位作者标注了工作完成于UMD）

summary_en.core_problem: This paper investigates how many intermediate steps in LLM-generated chain-of-thought reasoning traces are actually necessary for preserving the model's final prediction. It defines the 'minimal core'—the smallest subset of steps that preserves the original predictive behavior—to quantify overcompleteness in reasoning traces, and explores whether minimal cores reveal a cleaner representation geometry of reasoning (compactness, correctness-separability, intrinsic dimensionality).
summary_en.importance: Three key implications for pretraining research: (1) The finding that 46% of reasoning steps are removable on average has direct implications for process supervision data strategy—not all intermediate steps deserve equal supervision weight. (2) Minimal cores transfer across model families, suggesting a universal reasoning structure exists beneath model-specific stylistic variation. (3) Minimal-core embeddings are more compact, lower-dimensional, and more correctness-informative than full-trace embeddings, providing a new lens for evaluating and compressing reasoning capability. From a data efficiency perspective, if large portions of reasoning traces are redundant, synthetic reasoning training data can be more focused.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core method frames trace analysis as a subset-sufficiency problem. Given model M, input x, and full trace z=(r1,...,rT), the method checks for each subset S⊆[T] whether the model's prediction conditioned on x+z_S matches the prediction conditioned on the full trace. A greedy deletion algorithm (iteratively removing the step whose deletion least affects prediction) extracts minimal cores. Metrics include compression ratio, redundancy mass, step necessity, and necessity concentration. The paper provides theoretical guarantees for existence, local minimality under greedy deletion, overcompleteness certificates, and sparse-necessity structure. For representation geometry, it analyzes embedding space properties of full traces, minimal cores, and removed steps.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across six deliberative reasoning benchmarks: GSM8K (arithmetic), MATH500, AIME24, AMC23 (competition math), GPQA-Diamond (expert scientific reasoning), and StrategyQA (commonsense multi-hop QA). Across model families, greedy minimal-core extraction removes 46% of steps on average while largely preserving the full-trace answer. Predictive support is concentrated in a small number of steps (high necessity concentration). Minimal cores transfer across model families—a core extracted from model A preserves prediction on model B. Representation geometry analysis shows minimal-core embeddings are more compact, lower-dimensional, and more correctness-informative than either full-trace or removed-step embeddings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Chapter 1 for the conceptual framework of overcomplete reasoning traces and motivation. Chapter 2 formalizes minimal cores, metrics, and theoretical guarantees—this is the methodological core. The experimental results (Chapter 3) with the 46% average removability finding and necessity concentration analysis are the key empirical contributions. The representation geometry section (Chapter 4) adds embedding-space insights. Prioritize: overcompleteness quantification per benchmark, necessity concentration visualizations, and cross-model transfer experiments. Reading time: 25-35 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Author affiliations not fully specified; one author notes work done while at UMD (University of Maryland)

recommendation.zh: CoT冗余度的量化结果可用于优化推理预训练的数据筛选，仅看第3节度量定义和第4节实验统计即可
recommendation.en: Quantified CoT redundancy results can inform reasoning pretraining data filtering, only read Section 3 for metrics and Section 4 for experimental stats

paper.title: Robust LLM Unlearning Against Relearning Attacks: The Minor Components in Representations Matter
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) unlearning aims to remove specific data influences from pre-trained model without costly retraining, addressing privacy, copyright, and safety concerns. However, recent studies reveal a critical vulnerability: unlearned models rapidly recover "forgotten" knowledge through relearning attacks. This fragility raises serious security concerns, especially for open-weight models. In this work, we investigate the fundamental mechanism underlying this fragility from a represen

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 LLM unlearning 为什么容易被 relearning attack 逆转，并提出一个表示几何解释：现有 unlearning 主要改动表示空间的 dominant components，而这些方向在后续再微调中更容易被恢复；minor components 改动较少，但恢复阻力更大。
summary.importance: 这篇论文属于 post-training safety/unlearning，但对预训练研究有一个明确启发：模型知识删除不能只看短期 loss 或 benchmark 降低，还要看参数和表示变化是否落在容易被常规训练恢复的高方差子空间。这个观察也能反向提醒 continual pretrain 和安全微调：训练信号往往优先沿表示谱的主方向生效，因此看似强的遗忘或抑制可能只是可逆的表示偏移。贡献量级是机制分析加方法改进，不是通用预训练框架。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先回顾 GA、NPO、RMU、MLP Breaking 等 unlearning 方法，再从内部表示的谱结构出发，把表示分解为 dominant components 和 minor components。核心发现是，常规 unlearning 优化更容易沿 dominant directions 改变模型；relearning attack 或普通下游微调也主要沿这些方向更新，因此会较快恢复被压低的知识。基于这个分析，作者提出 Minor Component Unlearning，显式把 unlearning 压力施加到表示的 minor-component 子空间。这样做的取舍是牺牲一部分最容易优化的方向，换取更难被后续训练恢复的遗忘效果。它和 RMU 这类随机控制向量方法的差异在于，MCU 不只是扰动表示，而是按表示谱结构选择干预方向。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 WMDP-Cyber、WMDP-Bio 和 Years 数据集，评估 unlearning 后的初始遗忘效果、relearning attack 后的知识恢复率，以及 retain/utility 表现。论文报告现有方法在 relearning 下恢复率很高，文中引用的强评测中可超过 88%。MCU 在这些设置下显著降低 relearning 后的知识恢复，同时维持无关任务上的模型效用。结果还支持机制假设：dominant components 在 unlearning 中变化更大，但在 relearning 中更容易回到原状态；minor components 的恢复更慢，因此更适合作为稳健遗忘的干预方向。由于给出的内容未包含完整表格，具体逐项数字需要回到实验表和附录核对。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 到 40 分钟。优先看表示分解和理论分析部分，确认 dominant/minor components 的定义、投影位置和恢复率度量。实验部分重点看 WMDP-Cyber、WMDP-Bio、Years 上 relearning attack 前后的对比表，以及 utility 保持结果。若只关心预训练启发，可以重点读谱结构分析和 recovery dynamics 图；若做 unlearning 方法，则需要细读 MCU 的 loss 设计、使用哪一层表示、子空间维度选择和超参数敏感性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why LLM unlearning is fragile under relearning attacks. Its main explanation is geometric: existing methods mostly change dominant representation components, while these components are also the easiest ones for later fine-tuning to recover. Minor components are changed less, but are harder to reverse once targeted.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly about post-training unlearning, but it has a clear implication for pretraining and continual training research. A drop in loss or benchmark performance after unlearning does not necessarily mean the knowledge has been removed from hard-to-recover parts of the model. If the intervention lies in high-variance representation directions, ordinary fine-tuning can quickly undo it. This also informs safety-oriented continual pretraining: training signals tend to act first on dominant spectral directions, so apparent forgetting can be a reversible shift rather than durable removal.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper reviews common unlearning methods such as Gradient Ascent, NPO, RMU, and MLP Breaking, then analyzes internal representations through their spectral structure. Representations are decomposed into dominant and minor components. The empirical and theoretical claim is that standard unlearning objectives preferentially modify dominant directions; relearning attacks also update these directions efficiently, which explains rapid recovery. Minor Component Unlearning, or MCU, instead applies the unlearning pressure to the minor-component subspace. The method differs from representation-misdirection approaches such as RMU because it does not merely push activations toward an arbitrary target; it chooses intervention directions according to the representation spectrum. The tradeoff is clear: MCU gives up some of the easiest optimization directions to obtain forgetting that is harder to reverse.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover WMDP-Cyber, WMDP-Bio, and Years. They evaluate immediate forgetting, recovery after relearning attacks, and utility on retained or unrelated tasks. The paper reports that existing unlearning methods can recover a large fraction of the forgotten knowledge under relearning, with cited evaluations showing recovery rates above 88%. MCU reduces post-attack recovery while preserving general utility. The experiments also support the mechanism: dominant components are strongly modified during unlearning but recover quickly during relearning, whereas minor components recover more slowly. The provided text does not include the full numerical tables, so exact per-dataset values should be checked in the experiment section and appendix.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25 to 40 minutes. Focus first on the representation decomposition and theoretical analysis: how dominant and minor components are defined, where the projection is applied, and how recovery is measured. In the experiments, prioritize the before-and-after relearning tables on WMDP-Cyber, WMDP-Bio, and Years, plus the utility retention results. Readers interested in pretraining dynamics can mainly read the spectral analysis and recovery-dynamics plots. Readers working on unlearning should inspect the MCU loss, layer choice, subspace dimension selection, and hyperparameter sensitivity.
